title.zh: 活化能 · 反应要翻过的那座山
title.en: Activation Energy · The Hill a Reaction Has to Climb

desc.zh: 反应物要先爬上一座能量山才能变成生成物：山多高、有多少分子爬得上去，决定了反应有多快。
desc.en: Reactants must climb an energy hill before they become products: how high the hill is, and how many molecules can climb it, decides how fast the reaction goes.
